pages.text: Recovery restores 2% of maximum stamina per second: 2 at 100, 4 at 200, or 10 at 500. Larger pools allow longer work bursts and proportionally faster recovery.

Most workers rest after exhaustion until reaching 25% stamina, roughly thirteen seconds from zero at normal tick speed. Recovery opportunities depend on the job. Flight and sprinting have their own costs; see $(l:care/flight)Mounted flight$().
